detail: raw exception normalised to UNEXPECTED_ERROR: numerator.includes is not a function
note: The fraction converter assumes its operand is a string. vm/VMBuiltins.ts's converter table, index 95's handler. FIXED: PUSH_STRING now bounds-checks its constant-pool operand, so this stream is refused before the fraction/rate builtin sees a Uom whose unit is not a string. UOM_CONVERT also takes its unit name through stringOperand() now, so a non-string unit cannot be built into a Value at all.
